incidents.evidence: OpenAI repeatedly returned `Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.` before any provider usage event was accepted.
incidents.resolution: A later exact-selector retry succeeded. The first valid Beets SwarmVault and Graphify sessions were retained.

incidents.evidence: Controller `go mod download` failed on proxy.golang.org HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR responses while fetching pinned dependencies. Model execution never started.
incidents.resolution: A provider-free exact-tree preparation with `GODEBUG=http2client=0` subsequently passed, including native install, artifact hashes, MCP initialize, tools/list, and warmup.

incidents.evidence: The HTTP/1 dependency transport completed successfully, but OpenAI returned overload responses on every model attempt from 2026-07-30T10:25:59Z through 2026-07-30T11:00:17Z. Task 1 produced an empty event stream and no provider usage event.
incidents.preservation_result: The matrix rejected bounded copying because the incomplete run directory contained nested runtime state, retained the complete checkout, and exited fail-closed. No canonical or rejected session was registered.
incidents.cleanup: The 3.0 GB retained matrix directory was deleted after this receipt was committed because it contained no provider usage event and was outside the authoritative corpus.

incidents.evidence: Graphify completed AST extraction for 4,712 Terraform files, then its provider-free graph rebuild failed with `[Errno 28] No space left on device`; graph.json was absent and model execution never started.
incidents.resolution: The first valid Terraform SwarmVault session from the same matrix was retained. Duplicate/rejected lane state was deleted, 5.6 GB free space was confirmed, and a one-profile Terraform Graphify retry completed successfully without changing protocol, model, task, or treatment identity.

preservation_policy: First valid Fastify, Beets, and Terraform samples were retained; no accepted assignment was rerun. Only missing assignments were retried with the same published protocol, model condition, replicate, and bare OpenCode baseline.
